en.status_text: Already in your books: they expect these invoices from Foshan Home Retail Co.
en.title: Set up these terms in your books
en.intro: FLOW can add Foshan Home Retail Co.'s repeating invoices to your books, from the contract's own words, so the forecast counts on them. Nothing else in your books changes, and you can undo it.

terms.label: Each invoice
terms.quote: The Buyer shall pay the Supplier RMB 420,000 (four hundred and twenty thousand yuan) for each Batch

terms.label: Invoiced every
terms.quote: Batches are delivered every thirty (30) days, the first regular Batch on 3 October 2026, as set out in Schedule 1

terms.label: Next invoice
terms.quote: Batches are delivered every thirty (30) days, the first regular Batch on 3 October 2026, as set out in Schedule 1

terms.label: Paid within
terms.quote: Each invoice is payable forty-five (45) days after the Invoice Date

en.schedule_text: an invoice of ¥420,000.00 every 30 days from 3 Oct 2026 (in 2 days), each paid 45 days after its invoice date

not_set_up.label: Early payment
not_set_up.text: The buyer's option to pay early at a discount is not set up: the forecast never assumes an early payment.

not_set_up.label: Invoices the contract lists
not_set_up.text: Invoices already sent are not added: whether they were paid is for the bank to say.

not_set_up.label: Never from a contract
not_set_up.text: Cash, credit lines, loans, your limits and any concession are never set from a contract.

labels.why_not: Why it cannot be set up

confirm.title: Set up Foshan Home Retail Co.'s invoices in your books?
confirm.body: Your forecast will count on this money arriving on time. Only these invoices are added; you can undo it later. This is logged.

zh.status_text: 已在您的账簿中：账簿已计入来自Foshan Home Retail Co.的这些发票。
zh.title: 将这些条款记入账簿
zh.intro: FLOW 可以根据合同原文，把Foshan Home Retail Co.的循环发票记入账簿，让预测计入这些款项。账簿中其他内容不变，并且可以撤销。

terms.label: 每张发票
terms.quote: The Buyer shall pay the Supplier RMB 420,000 (four hundred and twenty thousand yuan) for each Batch

terms.label: 开票间隔
terms.quote: Batches are delivered every thirty (30) days, the first regular Batch on 3 October 2026, as set out in Schedule 1

terms.label: 下一张发票
terms.quote: Batches are delivered every thirty (30) days, the first regular Batch on 3 October 2026, as set out in Schedule 1

terms.label: 账期
terms.quote: Each invoice is payable forty-five (45) days after the Invoice Date

zh.schedule_text: 自2026年10月3日 (2 天后)起每 30 天开具一张 ¥420,000.00 的发票，每张在开票后 45 天付款

not_set_up.label: 提前付款
not_set_up.text: 买方享有折扣提前付款的选择权，此项不会设置：预测从不假设提前付款。

not_set_up.label: 合同列出的发票
not_set_up.text: 已开出的发票不会添加：是否已付款以银行记录为准。

not_set_up.label: 绝不来自合同
not_set_up.text: 现金、信用额度、贷款、您的规则以及任何让步都绝不会根据合同设置。

confirm.title: 将Foshan Home Retail Co.的发票记入账簿？
confirm.body: 您的预测将依赖这些款项按时到账。只添加这些发票；之后可以撤销。此操作会被记录。
